core_obligations: Approximate the pair (X, Z) at a finite level so that Z is the pullback of a closed subscheme with controlled scheme-theoretic image.
Apply the limit characterization of ampleness (lemma-ample-on-limit machinery) to reduce to the Noetherian ample-on-reduction statement at a finite level.
Close the constructible containment argument: ampleness on the reduction of the limit follows from ampleness on the reduction at a finite level plus constructibility.
proof_roadmap: Approximation of X and Z; scheme-theoretic image control.
Limit-ample criterion reduces to finite level.
Constructible containment closes the argument via the Noetherian lemma.
difficulty_reason: Approximation + scheme-theoretic image of Z + limit-ample criterion + constructible containment + the Noetherian ample-on-reduction lemma: five engines assembled.
